records.title: Circle Internet Group Q2 2026 Form 10-Q — USDC platform definitions, Circle Mint fiat flows and Coinbase distribution economics
records.note: Circle's Q2 2026 Form 10-Q reports USDC in circulation of USD73.269B at 2026-06-30 and a period average of USD76.524B. Circle's own 'USDC on platform' was USD12.442B at period end and 19.5% daily weighted-average share of USDC circulation. The filing defines Circle's platform to include Circle Mint accounts, corporate-held USDC and non-custodial wallets offered through Circle; this 19.5% is NOT Coinbase's platform share. Circle Mint customer fiat conversions: Q2 USD83.004B minted and USD86.784B redeemed (net -USD3.780B); H1 USD156.543B minted and USD158.540B redeemed (net -USD1.997B). Circle says Coinbase allocations under the Collaboration Agreement depend on USDC held on Coinbase's platform after issuer retention plus half of the remaining ecosystem-growth amount after approved third-party participant payments. Circle incurred distribution costs connected with Coinbase agreements of USD324.6M in Q2 and USD655.3M in H1. Q2 costs paid to Coinbase declined USD7.7M year over year as Coinbase's share of total average USDC on-platform balances decreased; H1 costs paid to Coinbase rose USD19.8M due higher reserve income partly offset by lower Coinbase share. Mint/redeem figures measure Circle Mint customer initiated fiat conversions, not all USDC secondary-market flows or total market supply changes. Circle's company-reported USD14.8T Q2 onchain transaction volume is not directly comparable to third-party adjusted-volume series.
